title: Atlas launch retro
summaryMarkdown: The team walked through the Atlas launch. Decision-making on the pricing page was slow, so going forward the pricing page copy is owned by marketing rather than engineering. After some back and forth the group settled on moving the public beta to June 18 so the Stripe webhook retries can land first. Priya is going to write the incident postmortem for the checkout outage, and Marco will pair with Northwind's admin to migrate their workspace before the beta.
